file_name.description: The name to save the file under, without a folder, e.g. "Account discovery report". Made safe and given the format's extension. Optional: without it the skill uses the content's title, else "document".

format.description: The file format. md for a Markdown report (the default), csv for a table, json for structured data, txt for plain text, html for a web page.

content_hint.description: Optional: which earlier output to save when there are several, e.g. "the report_markdown of the report step". Without it the skill saves the most recent finished document.
